acceptance: Bar-inferred simulation, observed-quote simulation, and observed broker fills have explicit fidelity labels; performance totals cannot combine distinct labels.
verified: All three fidelity classes are accepted and totaled independently.
An aggregate spanning multiple fidelity classes raises MixedFidelity.
limitations: OBSERVED_BROKER is a supported receipt label only; this does not indicate any broker fills were observed.
This guards receipt-level aggregation. Consumers that independently build reports must continue to use fidelity-filtered totals.
